scenarios.name: Switch compact command groups in the left-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify and Work Features buttons visible
no adjacent group panel is open
the user selects the Work Features group button
an adjacent panel lists Plane, Axis, Point, and UCS
the user selects the Modify group button
an adjacent panel lists Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, Draft, and other Modify commands
the user clicks empty workspace outside the part
the ribbon remains docked on the left
